question: Which city hosted the 55th International Film Festival of India in November 2024?​
solution:
The correct answer is __**Panaji**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **55th International Film Festival of India (IFFI)** is scheduled to be held in **November 2024** in Panaji, Goa.
 
• Panaji has been the permanent venue for the International Film Festival of India since **2004**.
 
• The IFFI is organized jointly by the **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting**, Government of India, and the Entertainment Society of Goa (ESG).
 
• It is one of the most significant film festivals in Asia, showcasing an extensive range of **world cinema** and honoring film excellence.
 
• The festival serves as a platform for fostering global cinematic exchange and offers opportunities for budding filmmakers.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **International Film Festival of India (IFFI):**

 
 
• Started in **1952**, it is the oldest film festival in Asia.
 
• It aims to promote the art of cinema by bringing together filmmakers and audiences globally.
 
• IFFI features categories like **International Competition**, Indian Panorama, Masterclasses, and Special Screenings.
 
 
 
• **Goa as a Permanent Venue:**
 
 
• In 2004, Goa was declared the permanent venue for IFFI due to its infrastructure and scenic appeal.
 
• The festival is hosted at venues like **Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Indoor Stadium** and Inox Multiplex.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Information and Broadcasting:**
 
 
• The ministry oversees the organization of IFFI in collaboration with state governments and other partners.
 
• It promotes Indian cinema globally through initiatives like IFFI.
 
 
 
• **Significance of IFFI:**
 
 
• The festival serves as a platform for **cultural exchange** and dialogue between global filmmakers.
 
• It also provides a significant boost to the Indian tourism and entertainment industries.
